name: Studio Nail & Spa
eyebrow: Nail salon · Tower Point, College Station
tagline: Manicures, pedicures and fill-ins at Tower Point on William D. Fitch Parkway.
about: Studio Nail & Spa is a nail salon at 943 William D. Fitch Pkwy, Suite 201, in the Tower Point center in south College Station.
They offer manicures, pedicures, fill-ins and polish changes, and they do dip powder nails too.
address: 943 William D Fitch Pkwy, Ste 201, College Station, TX 77845
hours_source: Hours as listed on Yelp; other listings show weekdays closing at 7 PM. Call ahead to confirm.
conflicts: Weekday closing time is 8 PM on Yelp and 7 PM on Wheree. Prices were not confirmed.
